item.title: I talk a lot about decentering a man, which is why its ironic that one of my biggest accomplishments is…
item.dc:creator: Katy Liftz · Instagram
item.description:
I talk a lot about decentering a man, which is why its ironic that one of my biggest accomplishments is loving this man.

Loving him with the depth that I do took SO much work on myself to feel safe around a man in general.

When we dated I woke up in the night in a cold sweat sometimes, scared shitless at the level of vulnerability I was choosing by allowing him into my home.

Our wedding night I shook in the bathtub having panic attacks spiraling as every memory of abuse played across my eyelids in a flurry.

And it had nothing to do with him, and everything to do with the past I had experienced.

He was a friend to me the whole way. A best friend, who offered a laugh when I wanted one and silence when I needed to share.

The work he did to earn my favor was nothing in comparison to the work I did on myself to be able to love him so purely. I knew he deserved it.

He earned it every day for years as we worked together in perfect tandem as shipmates, and best friends.

I know I talk a lot about decentering men and I still 10/10 recommend that.

But I also recommend doing the work to heal from your hurt so that you can be loved and receive it in full.

You deserve it.

Do the work for you to move on, and let the worst day of your life become just another bad Tuesday.
